edits: Idle periods shortened; browser chrome cropped; non-product browser/ChatGPT popups masked; explanatory captions added. All product footage is the live application and real user-approved passkey actions. No synthetic product state or audio was added.

clips.label: Orvena on Monad testnet
clips.caption: A passkey approval for one exact version of AI content.

clips.label: 1. Open an approval account
clips.caption: The user creates a real passkey with Windows Security. No seed phrase or wallet extension.

clips.label: 2. Approve the exact draft
clips.caption: A fresh passkey assertion authorizes this version. The sponsor pays testnet gas.

clips.label: 3. Verify without logging in
clips.caption: The verifier checks exact content, the independently trusted approver and current Monad state.

clips.label: 4. Change one word
clips.caption: Monday becomes Tuesday. The altered content fails verification.

clips.label: 5. Carry the receipt into another app
clips.caption: Our separately hosted publisher checks the same JSON receipt before publishing inside the demo.

clips.label: 6. Block the changed draft
clips.caption: The publisher rejects the altered version. Earlier published content remains visible.

clips.label: 7. Revoke with a fresh passkey
clips.caption: The owner confirms another device challenge. Monad records the revocation.

clips.label: 8. Check again after revocation
clips.caption: Even the original version is now revoked. The draft is a prepared example, with no live model.
